build_sync_bucket: build a sync between a local directory and a HuggingFace bucket using source and dest paths with filtering options
create_filter_matcher: create a FilterMatcher that matches file paths against include and exclude fnmatch patterns
test_sync_plan: test the sync plan computation by comparing local and remote files to determine upload, download, and delete operations
refactor_sync_plan: refactor the sync plan to support dry run mode that writes the plan as JSONL to stdout without executing
review_execute_plan: review the plan execution that batches upload and delete operations via the HfApi for bucket sync
